notes.title: The Adventurer Episode 2 - released
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

Tthanks for all customers who supported this project.
Episode 2 is finally released.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1320110/The_Adventurer__Episode_2_New_Dreams/

Episode 2 is a sequel to popular Adventurer game where the main protagonist dive into the new adventure whenever he goes to sleep.
Will he be able to wake up or stay forever in the dream it's up to you.

If you already own Episode 1 you can simply buy the bundle and safe 30%

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18034/The_Adventurer_Episode_12/
